author: opencode-worker-5
text: Investigation report 2026-08-31 (worker-5): I could NOT reproduce the anomaly, and every reproducible path converges on adc14011f82d1c56... — evidence below. The reported 78f58a98c28ee570 is not derivable by any variant I can construct, which shifts suspicion toward the CAPTURE environment (worker-3's generator process), not the algorithm. Evidence: (1) in-process interleave reproduction — main()-site derive, sign(), crypto_core_ed25519_is_valid_point, a 1000x crypto_core_ed25519_scalar_reduce storm, and an importlib.reload of lichen.crypto.schnorr48 ALL return adc14011 (no hidden nacl/libsodium scalar state observable). (2) 50 fresh processes with the exact reported main()/sign_claim() call pattern: 50/50 identical adc14011, 0 failures. (3) Dual-import hypothesis checked: sys.modules holds exactly one lichen.crypto.schnorr48; module file matches this checkout. (4) Historical variants all yield adc14011 too — reference_schnorr48.py (the independent vector oracle, in-tree) agrees with lichen.crypto.schnorr48 (same privkey AND pubkey for the seed); its clamp differs (s[31] &= 63 vs &= 127) but both clamp to the same value on real seeds; PyNaCl 1.3.0/1.4.0/1.5.0/1.6.0/1.6.1/1.6.2 (including bundled older libsodium ABIs) all return adc14011. (5) Exhaustive sweeps for 78f58a98: neighbor seeds range(lo,lo+32) for all lo in 0x00..0xFF (forward and backward), repeated-byte seeds, raw-seed-as-scalar, clamped-seed-direct, sha256-path, hex-encoded-seed, reversed seed, sha512(seed)-as-seed — NONE match. CONCLUSION: the function is pure and deterministic across every reachable environment; 78f58a98 was very likely produced by a genuinely different code path or module instance in the worker-3 capture (e.g. a since-modified working tree — the generator gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.py does not exist in this tree), not by hidden state. Recommended next step for the crypto owner: re-run the capture on worker-3's environment with the hex-print instrumentation still in place, or close as unreproducible-if-capture-environment-is-gone. The self-check refusing to emit invalid vectors remains the correct guard either way. Blocking bead nwjl.5 can proceed on the adc14011 identity — the generator-side self-verify gate makes it impossible for the anomaly to corrupt committed vectors.
